name: Notification Grouper
description: Group notifications by the app that sent them. Zero-config; generic names are grouped under that name, only senders that declare no name at all stay isolated per process.
_note: shell-version declares 50 only (this extension was checked point by point against 50.1 across every patch surface: the two daemon methods, the per-instance open() and above-cap addNotification overrides on the stacks it serves, the three prototype workarounds in uiWorkarounds.js, and the extension's own schema read path; runtime verification is complete). 48/49 are source-level compatible but not runtime-verified, so they are not declared. See MAINTENANCE.md for the dependency list.
